options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Progressive Parts
options.doc: Pod racer parts will always be the next level upgrade

options.name: No Traction Upgrades
options.doc: Removes Traction parts from the item pool

options.name: Course Unlock Mode
options.doc:
Sets how courses should unlock
Full Shuffle: All course unlocks are fully shuffled. Recommended for moderate to longer games and asyncs.
Circuits: Access to entire circuits is shuffled. Recommended for a shorter game.
Progressive Circuits: Access to entire circuits is shuffled, and you will always unlock them in order. Recommended for a shorter game.

options.name: Randomize Starting Racers
options.doc: Changes which racers are available to use at the beginning
options.doc_fr: Changements que les coureurs peuvent utiliser au début

options.name: Number of Starting Racers
options.doc:
How many random racers to start with
This option is only used if 'Randomize Starting Racers' is enabled

options.name: Starting Racers Plando
options.doc:
List of specific racers with which to start
This option is only used if 'Randomize Starting Racers' is enabled

options.name: Max Additional Racers
options.doc: How many racers can be added to the pool (excluding the starting racers)

options.name: Mirrored Tracks
options.doc: How many tracks should be mirrored

options.name: Disable Part Damage
options.doc:
Prevents parts from being damaged and removes pit droids from the item pool
This does not remove the pit droid shop checks, just the pit droids themselves
Extra money will be added to the pool to compensate

options.name: AI Scaling
options.doc:
Affects AI speed
Vanilla: Courses use their default scaling, which may result in tough races early on
Circuits: AI is scaled according to the current circuit
Parts: AI is dynamically scaled according to the quality of your parts
options.doc_fr:
Influe sur la vitesse de l'IA
Vanilla: Les cours utilisent leur échelle par défaut, ce qui peut entraîner des courses difficiles tôt sur Circuits : l'IA est graduée selon le circuit actuel
Parts: L'IA est dynamiquement graduée selon la qualité de vos pièces

options.name: Additional AI Multiplier
options.doc:
Applies additional scaling to AI
1000 = 1.000
options.doc_fr:
Applique une échelle supplémentaire à l'IA
1000 = 1.000

options.name: Enable Multiplier Control
options.doc: Allows the player to change the additional AI multiplier in-game
options.doc_fr: Permet au joueur de changer le multiplicateur AI supplémentaire dans le jeu

options.name: 1-Lap Mode
options.doc: Races only require 1 lap to complete

options.name: Auto-Hint Shop
options.doc: Automatically hints shop items as they unlock
options.doc_fr: Indique automatiquement les articles de magasin comme ils déverrouillent

options.name: Shop Costs
options.doc:
Sets the cost of items at Watto's shop
Vanilla: Prices are unchanged. Some may require grinding truguts to afford
Normalized: Prices are much closer together, with some categories being slightly more expensive than others
Tiered: Each tier of any part type is an identical cost to that of other parts. This is the cheapest option

options.name: Shop Cost Multiplier
options.doc: Additional multiplier for shop costs
options.doc_fr: Multiplicateur supplémentaire pour les frais de magasin

options.name: Course Plando
options.doc:
Sets specific courses
For mirrored, append ' (Mirrored)' to any course name
Repeated courses will cause errors

options.name: Death Link Amnesty
options.doc: Amount of times you can crash your pod before sending a DeathLink to the server
options.doc_fr: Nombre de fois que vous pouvez planter votre pod avant d'envoyer un DeathLink au serveur

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
